solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Through barrier, behold king in city

indicators.note: 'in' tells us the pieces before it go inside the barrier word

parts.note: a fence is a barrier
lo is an old word meaning behold or look
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A traveller passes through a barrier and spots a king somewhere in a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Through barrier' is part of the surface journey; the barrier gives the outer word, with LO and R put inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Florence is a famous Italian city, capital of Tuscany.

clue.text: Passing fashion due finally to lose appeal

parts.note: a fad is a short-lived craze

indicators.note: 'finally' points to the last letter of the word due

parts.note: its last letter is used

explanation.surface: A short-lived fashion is bound in the end to stop attracting people.
explanation.definitionFit: To fade is to grow dim or weaker, so something that fades loses its appeal over time.

clue.text: Which side is the monarch on?

definitions.text: Which side is the monarch on?

parts.words: Which side is the monarch on?
parts.note: on a coin the sovereign's head appears on the front face, which has a special name

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a question about royal politics or loyalty, but it is about coins: the side bearing the monarch's head.
explanation.definitionFit: The obverse is the face of a coin or medal carrying the principal design, traditionally the ruler's portrait.

clue.text: Ignore stain that's ruined cutlery

indicators.note: something ruined is wrecked, so these letters are broken up and rebuilt

parts.note: the anagram fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: Someone tells you to overlook a mark on knives and forks that have been spoiled.
explanation.walkthrough: Eating irons is a jokey informal name, chiefly British, for knives, forks and spoons.
explanation.definitionFit: Eating irons is a humorous slang term for the knives, forks and spoons used at meals.

clue.text: Pa can't somehow snooze for a while

indicators.note: 'somehow' suggests the letters reach the answer by some unspecified rearrangement

parts.note: the anagram fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: Dad is somehow unable to have a short sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A catnap is a short, light sleep taken during the day, a brief doze.

clue.text: Wife following the trend producing creamy sweet

parts.note: hip means fashionable, in line with the trend

explanation.surface: A wife keeps up with fashion by making a creamy dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: A whip is a light dessert made with whipped cream or egg whites.
explanation.definitionFit: A whip is a dessert of whipped cream or egg whites, often flavoured with fruit.

clue.text: Tongue needs iodine applied to back

indicators.note: 'applied to' attaches the iodine symbol onto the end of the back word

parts.note: hind means at the back, as in hind legs
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A sore tongue gets iodine dabbed on its rear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' looks like a body part receiving iodine, but it gives the adjective HIND.
explanation.definitionFit: Hindi is a major language of India; tongue here means language.

clue.text: Offers, being there, to speak

indicators.note: 'to speak' says the word is to be said aloud, giving its sound

parts.note: presence is the state of being there

explanation.surface: Someone attending a meeting makes offers, there in person, in order to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, PRESENCE sounds like the answer, which also means offers as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To present something is to offer or hand it over, so presents means offers.

clue.text: In spot, one very disturbed piece of turf

indicators.note: 'In' at the start says the following pieces go inside the spot word

parts.note: a dot is a small spot
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: On some spot, a single very disturbed chunk of grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disturbed' looks like an anagram signal but belongs to the definition: a divot is turf disturbed by a club.
explanation.definitionFit: A divot is a chunk of turf gouged out by a golf club or hoof.

clue.text: Novice has shower in shirt

indicators.note: 'in' puts the shower word inside the shirt word

parts.note: tee is short for T-shirt
a shower is a fall of rain

explanation.surface: A newcomer takes a shower still wearing their shirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shower' suggests washing, but it is a rain shower.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee is someone learning a job, a beginner or novice.

clue.text: Sort of teaching aid maybe as usual I avoid messing up

indicators.note: messing up means throwing into disorder, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: the anagram fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: As is my habit, I steer clear of making a mess of the teaching aid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As' is only a link; the fodder is USUAL I AVOID.
explanation.definitionFit: Audiovisual aids such as films and slides are a familiar kind of classroom teaching resource using sound and pictures.

clue.text: Ordinary people that are controlled by castle

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the common members of a group, as opposed to its leaders
second meaning: in chess the castle (rook) moves along ranks and files, the board's rows and columns

explanation.walkthrough: 'Castle' suggests a feudal lord ruling commoners, but it is the chess piece, which commands rows (ranks) and columns (files).
explanation.definitionFit: Rank and file originally meant soldiers in their lines, hence the ordinary members of any body.

clue.text: Organ of body, lacking energy, managed? Excellent

indicators.note: 'lacking' means going without, so the energy letter is dropped

parts.note: the spleen is an organ in the abdomen
E is the physics symbol for energy
did can mean managed, as in 'she did well'

explanation.surface: A body part working without energy somehow coped, which is excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Splendid is an enthusiastic term of approval meaning very fine or superb.

clue.text: Summary is not entirely accurate

indicators.note: 'not entirely' says the word is incomplete, losing its final letter

parts.note: precise means accurate

explanation.surface: A summary is not wholly accurate.
explanation.definitionFit: A précis is a brief written outline of a text's main points, an abstract.

clue.text: Little child is to clean dog perhaps

parts.note: to mop is to clean a floor with a mop
a dog is an example of a pet

explanation.surface: A small child's job is to wipe up after the family dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Moppet is an affectionate term for a small child, especially a little girl.

clue.text: One note lost in the hills; small coins remain

indicators.note: 'lost' says a letter goes missing from the hills word

parts.note: the Pennines are a range of hills running down northern England
N is an abbreviation for note, and only one of the N letters goes

explanation.surface: Someone loses a banknote out in the hills and is left with only small change.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pennines are the hill range forming the backbone of northern England; drop one N to get the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Pennies are low-value coins, a hundred to the British pound or the US dollar.

clue.text: Prohibit going round any fig tree

indicators.note: 'going round' says the prohibit word wraps around the next word

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit
taken as written

explanation.surface: Stop anyone walking round any fig tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The banyan is an Indian tree of the fig genus whose aerial roots become extra trunks.

clue.text: Lotion spilled in cabinet room

indicators.note: something spilled is scattered about, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the anagram fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: Some lotion has been knocked over in the government's meeting room.
explanation.definitionFit: Embrocation is a liquid rubbed onto the body to ease aching muscles or joints.

clue.text: Simple game: scrap a more difficult one

parts.note: to bin something is to scrap or throw it away
go is a subtle Asian board game, far harder than the simple game

explanation.surface: Someone suggests dropping a tricky game for an easy one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers back to 'game': go, the ancient strategy board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Bingo is a game of chance where players mark off called numbers, needing no skill.

clue.text: It's very dark in Kentucky

parts.note: KY is the postal abbreviation for Kentucky

explanation.surface: Nights in Kentucky are very dark.
explanation.definitionFit: Inky means black as ink, so it describes something very dark.

clue.text: Soap for a succession of rulers

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a famous 1980s American TV soap opera
second meaning: a line of hereditary rulers from one family

explanation.walkthrough: 'Soap' looks like the cleaning product but is a TV soap opera.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynasty is a series of rulers drawn from the same family; Dynasty was also a glossy TV serial.

clue.text: Marriage of our Jack?

definitions.meaning: second meaning; the question mark signals the word is half of that name

explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack' looks like a man's name, but it is the British flag, the Union Jack.
explanation.definitionFit: A marriage is a union of two people; the Union Jack is Britain's national flag.

clue.text: Emotional state rejected: that's fate

indicators.note: 'rejected' means sent back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a mood is an emotional state

explanation.surface: Someone turns away from their feelings and accepts that is their destiny.
explanation.definitionFit: Doom is a grim destiny or fate, usually death or ruin.

clue.text: Old Briton OK back in island

parts.note: the Angles were a Germanic people who settled in early Britain

indicators.note: 'back' means the agreement word is turned around

parts.note: yes means OK, agreed

explanation.surface: An ancient Briton gives approval for a return to the island.
explanation.walkthrough: Anglesey is an island off the north-west coast of Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Anglesey is a large island county lying off north-west Wales across the Menai Strait.
